result:
US-005 is built, but the story stays `in progress`: DoD-S-01 is not met. 11 of the 22 frozen backend tests pass. I did not start the stack, so the browser tests are not run.

The other 11 frozen tests set up or check their results through endpoints that belong to later stories:

| Frozen tests | Waiting on |
|---|---|
| AC-005-02, 04, 05, 10 and EX-005-02, 04, 05, 10 | `POST /contacts/search` (US-009) |
| AC-005-09, EX-005-12 | trash endpoint (US-012) |
| EX-005-09 | History and `/versions` (US-013, US-019) |

- **Backend:** I added the contact rules, create, open and save, and the minimum of the version recorder (the foundation, T-08) that creating a contact needs. The new tests pass (10 rule tests, 9 integration tests). Create and save write version 1 and the History entries. A stale save returns 409 `CONFLICT` with the current contact. Tags and attributes come back as empty lists until US-006 and US-008.
- **Frontend:** I added the contact screen with an "Add contact" button on the Contacts tab. It has the form, a read-only view for Viewers and for trashed contacts, and the conflict panel. The 123 Vitest tests pass, and tsc, eslint, prettier, spotless, PMD and CPD are clean.
- **Full backend run:** 263 of 461 tests fail, all on later stories. The three Us004 failures that were waiting on contacts still wait on History, search and `DELETE /me`. The JaCoCo report step fails with the known "malformed input" error.
- **Browser tests:** `contacts-form.spec.ts` needs the contacts list (US-009) to open a contact, so it can't pass yet either.
- **Order of work:** I wrote the screen code before its tests, so it was not red first. This is recorded in D-33, with the other readings, such as trimming spaces from text fields.

The next command is `/implement US-006`. The progress file, the decision log (D-33) and the logs are committed in three commits (backend, frontend, docs).
